title: VeilStream Systems
text:
VeilStream Systems

notes:
Lead: CTO Javier Ortiz is metric-driven — "we'll tolerate small quality delta for 3-4x $$ savings". SE call 2026-02-12: demo of Dedicated with prefix caching showed 35% token savings in synthetic tests. Security wants SAML + KMS + audit logs; EU data residency non-negotiable for trading desks. Good fit for Redwood Optimize recommendations (batch sizing + cache TTL tuning). POC scope agreed: 3-week perf + accuracy pass, then pilot in eu-west. Quote from trading eng: 'need deterministic tail latency during market open, can't burst-kill infra'.

Short CRM fragments below:
- 2026-01-20 initial intro (Maya) - interest in reducing serving cost for risk alerts
- 2026-02-05 technical deep dive (Liam) - discussed kv/prefix caching and shard routing
- 2026-02-12 perf demo (record: ff-20260212-042) - 35% token reduction, 18ms p50 baseline
- 2026-02-25 security questionnaire submitted (drive link)
- 2026-03-03 POC kickoff call (ff-20260303-091)
- 2026-03-08 first POC results: batching reduces GPU hours by ~28%, some hallucination regression in 4-bit baseline noted

POC notes: evaluate quantization profiles per model family; ensure canary fallback to unquantized variant when quality dips; want Redwood to run perf benchmark on Dedicated pool with customer-like traffic replay (we will provide traces).

next_step:
Complete performance POC (p95/throughput) and hand off security questionnaire to infra team

blockers:
legal review on EU data residency
uncertainty around 4-bit quantization accuracy
final sign-off on budget from CTO

perf_requirements:
Need reproducible benchmark harness. Request: 1) Redwood perf run with 8 concurrent clients, 1000 warmup requests, workloads: 32/128/1024 token contexts; 2) measure p50/p95/p99, GPU util, KV cache hit rates; 3) compare float16 vs 4-bit quantized model variants

latency_targets:
p50 < 20ms, p95 < 60ms for single-turn chat (payloads ~200 tokens); reranking p95 < 30ms for top-10 scoring

throughput_targets:
sustained 120 req/s for chat, spikes to 650 req/s for reranking windowing during market open

cost_sensitivity:
high - target amortized cost <$0.0007/token equivalent; interested in aggressive batching and quantization tradeoffs
